arguments.query: SELECT o.order_ts, i.unit_price_cents, i.quantity, p.list_price_twd FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) LIMIT 5
SELECT c.region_code, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) nc FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1

SELECT c.region_code, SUM(t.amt)/100.0/COUNT(*) aov, COUNT(*) n FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents) amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND strftime('%Y', datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY o.order_id) t JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2
